checks.name: integration isolation and loopback database bindings
existing accounts, refresh rotation and legacy JWT version zero remain valid
BFF requires origin and CSRF and rejects caller-assigned role
BFF customer registration stays pending until same-browser explicit confirmation
cross-browser confirmation requires a new password and sanitizes administrative return destinations
untrusted browser and Gateway IP headers cannot create forged rate-limit identities
duplicate email and concurrent registration cannot replace credentials or create two identities
resend cooldown persists and new generation invalidates the previous link
ADMIN employee invitation is idempotent and preserves role and null password until acceptance
EMPLOYEE and CUSTOMER cannot list invite resend or modify employee state directly or through BFF
employee chooses a password with one-use concurrent acceptance and cannot use the verification endpoint
private identity and email authorization APIs require purpose credentials and are absent from Kong
deactivation revokes refresh and every protected business API and open socket within 35 seconds
reactivation requires new login and keeps previous access and refresh tokens revoked
employee resend retires old invitation and disabling then enabling does not revive it
expired verification cannot activate an account
Rabbit outage preserves encrypted outbox atomically with pending identities
simulation remains unverified and SMTP retry attempts are bounded in isolated delivery workers
outbox and SMTP recover after Rabbit and Notification restart without duplicate messages
public request limits remain atomic and survive Auth service restart
terminal ciphertext is removed, audit and service logs exclude secrets, and previous identities remain intact

scope: Account onboarding phases 1-5; interface phase 6 is pending.
